meaning.zh:
“勉强糊口” 或 “靠天吃饭”。

这个短语源于人们过去实际生活的艰难状况，意为将手中的食物直接送到嘴里，象征着每次仅能满足当前的需求，无法储备。它形象地描绘了缺乏稳定收入和储蓄的状态，即人们只能依靠每日的收入来维持最基本的生活。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the literal act of bringing food from the hand directly to the mouth, symbolizing a state where one only meets their immediate needs without being able to save or plan for the future. It vividly depicts a condition of living without stable income or savings, relying on daily earnings for basic sustenance.

lines.en: Many people in developing countries still *live hand-to-mouth*.
lines.zh: 许多发展中国家的人们仍然在勉强糊口。

lines.en: After losing his job, he had to *live hand-to-mouth*.
lines.zh: 失去工作后，他不得不靠天吃饭。

lines.en: They've been *living hand-to-mouth* since their savings ran out.
lines.zh: 自从积蓄耗尽后，他们一直在勉强糊口。
